title: Cycle Redistribution Experiment: Dynamic Staff Pools & Forced Scope Slimming
creator: Priya Shah
description: Run a controlled experiment to test a short-term cycle-level staffing redistribution model using a dynamic pool of engineers and an enforced minimal-scope slimming process. Goal: surface whether temporary reallocation combined with a strict forced-slimming cadence reduces delivery slippage and improves our hit-rate on committed OKR milestones without incurring long-term context-switch costs.
acceptance_criteria: Define and publish the redistribution rules and forced-slimming checklist in Confluence
Execute the experiment across 3 cross-functional squads during 2026-W10 and capture daily burndown + context-switch metrics
Compare committed vs delivered scope across experiment squads vs control squads and show at least 15% reduction in unplanned scope slippage
Measure team-reported context-switch burden; no more than 10% increase in reported overhead vs control
Produce a recommendation doc with cost/benefit analysis and proposed guardrails for adoption or rollback
